Answers to Your Frequently Asked Questions
WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF FERULIC BREW?
In just 7 days, Ferulic Brew Facial Treatment boosts glow, smoothes texture, and reduces fine lines & wrinkles.* Ferulic Brew also provides antioxidant protection.
CAN I USE GLYCOLIC ACID AND LACTIC ACID TOGETHER?
Yes. However, since both are AHAs, consider one in the AM and the other in PM out of concern for possible sensitivity and barrier disruption. Additionally, we recommend avoiding sun exposure and always finishing your routine with SPF.
CAN I USE VITAMIN C AND LACTIC ACID TOGETHER?
Yes. In fact, applying Vitamin C after using Lactic Acid will ensure protection of newly exposed skin cells from free radical and oxidative damage.
IS LACTIC ACID AN AHA?
Yes. Lactic Acid is a unique AHA because of its affinity to skin and its strengthening, hydrating and pH balancing qualities. While every ingredient we use in our products is evaluated for safety, we do not specifically test our products on women who are pregnant or nursing. Kiehl's ensures there is substantial information supporting the safety of our products when used as directed by consumers. Yes, this product is synthetic-fragrance-free. There are natural fragrances within the formula, including Peppermint Oil.
WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN MILK PEEL AND FERULIC ESSENCE?
Milk Peel is a toner used with a cotton pad that hydrates with emollients while exfoliating with LHA. Ferulic Brew is a leave-on treatment applied with palms of hands that can be used as either a liquid serum or pre-serum treatment to enhance a routine.
